description: Rwanda - Power Plants is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Hydropower, Power system and utilities", published or maintained by Valerie Thomas (Georgia Institute of Technology). Rwanda's electricity generation is composed by domestic generation and the imported generation from neighbor countries and regional shared Company. The source of energy used is from the following sources: hydropower plants, thermal power plants (Diesel, Heavy fuel generators and methane gas) and solar energy. Coverage: Rwanda. It has 1 file in CSV. The portal files it under Hydropower, Power system and utilities, Thermal power. The portal gives 2016 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
